description.p: Veranda is a modern, GNOME-native application for managing Elgato Stream Deck devices on Linux. Bind keys with drag and drop, organize them into profiles and pages, and choose from a rich set of actions.

ul.li: Two-pane editor with live previews of every key
Actions: run a command, open a URL or folder, send hotkeys or text, trigger any GNOME keyboard shortcut, copy text, and control the deck
Special Buttons that update live: clock, date, now playing, unread counts, battery, system monitor, volume, network, weather, and more
Profiles and pages, with import and export
Per-key colors that follow the GNOME theme or accent color
Run in the background with a Quick Settings entry, lock-screen sync, and automatic profile switching based on the focused app

description.p: First release: editor, profiles, actions, Special Buttons, and deep GNOME integration (Quick Settings extension, lock sync, focus-based profile switching).
